messages:
Nina: Flagging a recurring handoff gap during last week's promo spike — some HubSpot leads stayed unassigned while enrichment hung. ~10-15m windows.
Carlos: Do you have a repro or sample IDs?
Nina: Yep, sample lead ids: 7f2c5, 8a9b1. Repro steps: fast intake -> enrichment webhook returns 202 but no score for a while -> RR wait condition blocks fallback.
Priya: This is the flow we added last quarter to prefer enriched leads, but we never added a hard timeout. We should avoid blocking forever.
Owen: Quick log snippet: 
```
[2026-02-18T09:06:12Z] intake: lead 7f2c5 created
[2026-02-18T09:06:14Z] enrich: webhook accepted (202) id=hook_42
[2026-02-18T09:20:30Z] assign: rr_check skipped (enrich pending)
```
So assign checks for enrich.score truthy, not for elapsed time.
Lena: Proposal: add per-connector enrich_timeout_seconds with sane default 300s. If pending > timeout then assign to overflow queue and annotate lead.meta.origin = "enrich_deferred".
Carlos: Important: preserve VIP path. For accounts with vip:true skip deferred rule. Also avoid creating outreach duplicates.
Priya: Dedupe approach: add outreach filter to ignore leads with meta.origin=enrich_deferred until enrich completes. When enrichment returns, merge the score onto the lead and clear origin tag. If outreach already attempted, mark for follow-up vs double-contact.
Owen: Telemetry needs: counter enrich_deferred_assigned, metric enrich_wait_seconds (histogram), and alert when enrich_deferred_assigned / daily_inbound > 0.3%.
Nina: Ops/Sales ops playbook updates: add SDR guidance for "enrich_deferred" leads (how to frame outreach, avoid duplicate outreach after enrichment). I'll draft language.
Lena: Canary plan: roll change to 15% of new leads for 48h with verbose logging + auto-rollback if duplicate_outreach_rate > 0.2% or median time-to-first-touch increases > 10%.
Carlos: Implementation notes: small change in handoff service: read connector.enrich_timeout_seconds, fallback to global. Minimal code: 
```
if (lead.enrich_status === 'pending' && now - lead.enrich_started_at > connector.enrich_timeout_seconds) {
  assignToOverflow(lead)
  lead.meta.origin = 'enrich_deferred'
}
```
Priya: Also add connector-level config in HubSpot mapping UI so Marketing can tune EMEA vs APAC vs US.
leadflow-bot: rollout-ticket created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/leadflow/pulls/1602 -> staging -> canary-15% -> prod.
Nina: Action items: Carlos -> PR for logic + config, Owen -> metrics + alerting, Priya -> playbook + UI flag, Lena -> canary runbook. Sync: tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar: 
Owen: I'll add the Prometheus counters and a Grafana panel.
Carlos: I'll include VIP opt-out and tests for no duplicate push to SF.
Priya: Drafting SDR note now, will post to #sales-ops for review.
Lena: I'll prepare rollback steps and monitoring runbook entries.
Nina: Great, thanks. This should cut down unowned lead tails and keep SLA promises. :thumbsup:
